text.EN: Thank goodness. That pack was massive.
text.TL: Salamat sa Diyos. Napakalaki ng kawang 'yon.

text.EN: Glad you made that call. Slipping away.
text.TL: Mabuti at nagpasya ka ng ganoon. Tatakas na tayo.

text.EN: Smart move. We live to fight another hour.
text.TL: Matalinong desisyon. Mabubuhay pa tayo sa susunod na oras.

text.EN: Relieved to hear that. Detouring now.
text.TL: Gumaan ang loob ko nang marinig 'yan. Iikot na ngayon.

text.EN: Good choice. Keep it quiet as we skirt past.
Much better than dying out here. Moving around.
text.TL: Mas maganda kaysa mamatay dito. Iikot na tayo.

text.EN: Sigh of relief. Let's keep our heads down.
Glad we're avoiding that bloodbath. Lead on.
text.TL: Mabuti at iniwasan natin ang katayang 'yon. Mauna ka na.

text.EN: Safe decision. Taking the alternate route.
text.TL: Ligtas na pasya. Dadaan sa ibang ruta.
